<!--
Use a Conventional Commit PR title:

fix:  ...	-> PATCH release (1.0.0 -> 1.0.1)
feat: ...	-> MINOR release (1.0.0 -> 1.1.0)

Add ! before the colon for a breaking change.

fix!: ...	-> MAJOR release (1.0.0 -> 2.0.0)

Other supported types do not bump the version unless they include a breaking change (!):

build:
chore:
ci:
docs:
perf:
refactor:
revert:
style:
test:
-->
